{{Top|leg}}
'''Mold exterminators''' were [[Drovian]]s who were tasked with elimination of the slimy [[carnivorous mold]]s that bred in the flooded canals of [[Bagsho]] free port on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nim Drovis]]. The mold exterminators patrolled the [[City/Legends|city]], armed with [[acidthrower]]s and [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]].<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
